profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at RequiTest, Inc.
profile.summary: My professional experience has been in the development of application software specializing in server and user services.  I have in-depth knowledge of the latest technology stack and a broad scope of experience in supporting the enterprise system.  I involved in the technical architecture design, strategy implementation, risk mitigation analysis, short and long term plan.  I designed, implemented, tested, deployed, delivered, and maintained vast products.  I am very strong with the analytical and mathematical, excellent in communication, interpersonal, management skill, and is capable to participate in various roles
